ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
